model_family: XLS-R / wav2vec2 (CTC) -- NOT the same architecture as this repo's Whisper-Small track
purpose: One-time comparison baseline to sanity-check the model's self-reported 5.97% WER and inform the backbone choice already made in Plans 1-4. Not a second fine-tuning/deployment track.

openslr43_in_domain.demographic_note: OpenSLR-43 has no speaker/gender metadata and is a single-speaker (female) corpus -- no within-corpus demographic breakdown is possible.

published_wer_comparison.note: measured on a 150-utterance slice of the same corpus, not an independent test set

openslr54_diversity_check.role: out-of-domain diversity check -- DIFFERENT corpus from OpenSLR-43, not directly comparable
openslr54_diversity_check.demographic_note: Breakdown uses NSTT-Lite's `gender` field, an F0-pitch acoustic pseudo-label (165Hz threshold), NOT verified/ground-truth gender. Results measure agreement with that heuristic, not true gender.

corpus_separation_note: OpenSLR-43 and OpenSLR-54 are DIFFERENT corpora and are never merged into a single 'OpenSLR' number anywhere in this report.
